name: decisions
description: A Decisions panel for Claude Code: Claude (or any Gas City agent, GPT included) posts the choices it needs from you as one-keypress questions, keeps working, and gets each answer back. Plus a Work of the day list with progress bars.

store.title: Where decisions live
store.description: local: this machine's Claude Code store, one list per project. beads: the Gas City city's beads, shared with agents on any model (they post with gc decisions ask).

gcPath.title: Path to gc
gcPath.description: Only for the beads store, when gc is not on PATH. Default: gc, then ~/.local/bin/gc.
